models.name: shopping_mall_configs
models.description:
Global configuration sets for the shoppingMall platform.

Represents named configuration groups and key/value style configuration documents that control behavior across multiple domains such as feature flags, thresholds, and default limits.

Configs are referenced logically by name or environment from application code rather than through foreign keys from business entities. Multiple configurations can coexist for different environments (for example production vs staging) while only one is active per environment and key at a time.

Historical changes are tracked by updated_at timestamps and soft deletion rather than separate snapshot tables, because business requirements emphasize current effective values and auditability over full temporal reconstruction.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the configuration set.

plainFields.name: namespace
plainFields.description:
Logical namespace grouping for this configuration set.
Examples: "checkout", "catalog", "reviews", "risk".
Used to avoid key collisions and to group related configuration entries.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description:
Business-level key identifying a particular configuration within the namespace.
Together with namespace and environment, this uniquely identifies a configuration document.

plainFields.name: environment
plainFields.description:
Environment where this configuration applies.
Typical values include "production", "staging", or "development".
Allows the platform to maintain different configuration values per environment.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Human-readable description of what this configuration controls.
Used by admins and operators to understand the impact of changes.

plainFields.name: value_json
plainFields.description:
Configuration payload encoded as JSON text.
Stores structured parameters such as thresholds, booleans, and feature flags.
Application code is responsible for validating and interpreting this JSON.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description:
Indicates whether this configuration entry is currently considered active.
Inactive entries are kept for historical reference but are ignored by runtime configuration loaders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the configuration is considered logically removed but retained for audit and rollback scenarios.

models.name: shopping_mall_countries
models.description:
Master data for countries used across the shoppingMall platform.

Defines the set of supported countries for customer addresses, shipping destinations, tax handling, and regional reporting.

Other components reference this table via foreign keys (for example customer addresses, warehouses, and seller configurations), but this model itself does not depend on downstream tables, keeping the foundational layer free of cyclic references.

Each country is identified by a stable ISO-like code and has display names and status flags to control availability.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the country record.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description:
Canonical country code, typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.
Used as a stable business identifier across the platform.

plainFields.name: name_en
plainFields.description: Country name in English used as the default display value when no localization is applied.

plainFields.name: phone_code
plainFields.description:
Optional international calling code prefix for the country.
Used in phone number formatting and validation where needed.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this country is currently enabled for use in addresses, shipping, and related flows.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description:
Integer value used to control display ordering in country selection lists.
Lower values are typically shown first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the country is logically removed from selection lists but retained for historical reference in orders and addresses.

models.name: shopping_mall_regions
models.description:
Sub-national or logical regions used for shipping, pricing, risk segmentation, and policy scoping.

Each region belongs to exactly one country and may represent states, provinces, or custom business-defined regions such as "EU-West" or "Metro Area".

Regions are referenced by shipping policies, seller warehouses, and risk rules, enabling fine-grained control over availability, fees, and risk treatments per geographic area.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the region.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_country_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key referencing the country this region belongs to.
Links to {@link shopping_mall_countries} for country-level metadata and validation.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description:
Business-level code for the region within its country.
May represent ISO subdivision codes or internal identifiers.
Unique per country.

plainFields.name: name_en
plainFields.description: Region name in English used as a default display label.

plainFields.name: region_type
plainFields.description:
Optional semantic classification of the region, such as "state", "province", "city", or a custom business type.
Used for reporting and UI grouping.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this region is enabled for use in shipping, risk, and address validation.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description:
Display ordering value within the country.
Lower values appear earlier in region selection lists.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this region record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this region record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the region is not offered for new operations but remains referenced in historical orders and addresses.

models.name: shopping_mall_region_shipping_policies
models.description:
Region-specific shipping capability and constraint configurations.

Defines how shipping behaves for a given region, including whether shipping is allowed, which carrier or method group is preferred, and high-level business constraints such as minimum or maximum order amounts.

This table does not store runtime shipment records but rather acts as configuration used by checkout validation and shipping option calculation.

Entries are subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_regions} and can be changed without affecting historical shipments, which retain their own snapshots.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the region shipping policy.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_region_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key referencing the region this shipping policy applies to.
Targets {@link shopping_mall_regions} to scope shipping rules geographically.

plainFields.name: policy_name
plainFields.description:
Human-readable name of the shipping policy for this region.
Used mainly in admin tools and configuration UIs.

plainFields.name: shipping_method_group
plainFields.description:
Optional identifier of a shipping method group or profile that this region prefers.
For example, a code that maps to specific carriers or service levels used elsewhere.

plainFields.name: min_order_amount
plainFields.description:
Minimum order total required for shipping to be allowed in this region.
Expressed in the platform base currency unless configured otherwise.

plainFields.name: max_order_amount
plainFields.description:
Maximum order total for which this particular policy is applicable.
Can be used to route high-value orders through different workflows.

plainFields.name: allows_cod
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether cash-on-delivery or pay-on-delivery is allowed for this region, subject to global payment configuration.

plainFields.name: is_shipping_allowed
plainFields.description:
Flag indicating whether the platform allows any shipping to this region at all.
If false, checkout for addresses mapped to this region must be blocked.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-form notes for operators explaining special conditions or rationale for this policy.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description:
Optional start timestamp from which this policy becomes effective.
Null means effective immediately or since system initialization.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description:
Optional end timestamp after which this policy is no longer considered.
Null means no predefined expiration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this region shipping policy was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this region shipping policy was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, this policy is ignored by business logic but kept for historical audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Global product category taxonomy for the shoppingMall platform.

Represents hierarchical categories used to organize products for navigation, search filtering, commissions, and reporting.

Each category has a single parent except root categories, and the transitive hierarchy is materialized through {@link shopping_mall_category_closures}. Localized labels are stored in {@link shopping_mall_category_localizations}.

Categories support lifecycle states such as active, hidden, or deprecated, enabling controlled evolution of the taxonomy without breaking historical product assignments.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the category.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description:
Optional self-referential foreign key to the parent category.
Null indicates a root category.
Used together with {@link shopping_mall_category_closures} to represent the hierarchy.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description:
URL-friendly and unique slug used to identify the category in external-facing links and integrations.
Unique among siblings to prevent conflicts.

plainFields.name: name_en
plainFields.description: Category name in English serving as the default label when localization is not applied.

plainFields.name: description_en
plainFields.description: Optional English description that explains the scope and usage of this category.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Lifecycle status of the category.
Typical values include "active", "hidden", and "deprecated".
Controls visibility and eligibility for new product assignments.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description:
Ordering value used to control the display order among sibling categories.
Lower values appear earlier in navigation menus.

plainFields.name: is_leaf
plainFields.description:
Flag indicating whether the category is currently considered a leaf in the hierarchy.
Primarily used for UI optimizations and validation rules for product assignment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the category is no longer offered for new assignments but remains preserved for historical orders and catalog snapshots.

models.name: shopping_mall_category_closures
models.description:
Closure table representing all ancestor–descendant relationships between categories.

Supports efficient hierarchical queries such as retrieving all descendants of a category, all ancestors of a leaf, or computing breadcrumb paths without recursive queries.

Each record links an ancestor category to a descendant category with an integer depth. Depth 0 rows represent reflexive relationships (a category as its own ancestor).

This table is purely structural and is managed by application logic whenever the category tree changes.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the category closure row.

foreignFields.name: ancestor_category_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the ancestor category in the hierarchy.
References {@link shopping_mall_categories}.

foreignFields.name: descendant_category_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the descendant category in the hierarchy.
References {@link shopping_mall_categories}.

plainFields.name: depth
plainFields.description:
Number of edges between ancestor and descendant.
Depth 0 means ancestor and descendant are the same category.
Depth 1 means direct parent–child relationships.

models.name: shopping_mall_category_localizations
models.description:
Localized labels and descriptions for categories.

Stores localized names, descriptions, and optional SEO-related fields for each category and locale.

This table enables multi-language category trees without duplicating structural information; the hierarchy itself is defined in {@link shopping_mall_categories} and {@link shopping_mall_category_closures}.

Each (category, locale) pair is unique, and English defaults remain in the primary category table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the category localization entry.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key referencing the category that this localization belongs to.
Targets {@link shopping_mall_categories}.

plainFields.name: locale
plainFields.description:
Locale code for this localization, such as "en-US", "ko-KR", or "ja-JP".
Used by the application to select appropriate translations.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Localized category name displayed to end users for the specified locale.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional localized description that explains the category in the specified language.

plainFields.name: seo_title
plainFields.description:
Optional localized SEO title for the category.
Used in page metadata where applicable.

plainFields.name: seo_description
plainFields.description:
Optional localized SEO description for the category.
Used in page metadata where applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category localization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category localization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, this localization is no longer used for rendering but remains preserved for audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_business_policies
models.description:
Logical business policy definitions used to govern behavior such as refunds, reviews, seller performance, and risk thresholds.

Represents high-level policy objects that are versioned through {@link shopping_mall_policy_versions}. Each policy groups multiple versions over time, with metadata describing the policy domain and purpose.

Policies are referenced by other components (for example refund systems, review moderation, or risk engines) through stable identifiers, while the active version is chosen based on effective dates and status in the version table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the business policy.

plainFields.name: policy_code
plainFields.description:
Stable business identifier for the policy, such as "refund_standard", "review_content", or "seller_performance".
Used by other systems to refer to the policy independent of specific versions.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description:
Human-readable name of the policy.
Displayed in admin dashboards and configuration tools.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description:
Broad classification of the policy domain.
Examples include "refund", "review", "seller", "risk", or "shipping".
Used for filtering and analytics.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Detailed description of the policy and business intent.
Helps admins understand what behavior this policy governs.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description:
Flag indicating whether this policy is currently in use.
Inactive policies are preserved for audit but not used when choosing effective versions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this business policy definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this business policy definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the policy is logically retired but remains referenced by historical policy versions and cases.

models.name: shopping_mall_policy_versions
models.description:
Versioned instances of business policies specifying concrete rules, thresholds, and descriptive texts.

Each record belongs to a {@link shopping_mall_business_policies} row and defines a particular version with an effective date range, status, and serialized rule parameters.

This allows the platform to change policies over time while keeping a precise history of what rules were in effect when specific orders, reviews, or disputes occurred.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the policy version.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_business_policy_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key referencing the logical business policy that this version belongs to.
Targets {@link shopping_mall_business_policies}.

plainFields.name: version_code
plainFields.description:
Business-facing identifier for this version of the policy.
Examples: "v1", "2024-01", or semantic version strings.
Uniquely identifies versions per policy.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description:
Short title or heading summarizing the key intent of this policy version.
Shown in admin tools and audit views.

plainFields.name: body_markdown
plainFields.description:
Full policy body content expressed as Markdown text.
Contains human-readable rules that may also be surfaced to customers or sellers.

plainFields.name: parameters_json
plainFields.description:
Optional JSON-encoded structured parameters for programmatic evaluation.
Might contain numeric thresholds, time windows, and flags that engines use when enforcing the policy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Status of this policy version.
Typical values include "draft", "active", and "retired".
Only active versions should be used for new decisions.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description:
Timestamp from which this policy version becomes applicable.
Null means effective immediately from creation or when status becomes active.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description:
Timestamp after which this policy version is no longer applicable.
Null means no scheduled expiry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this policy version was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this policy version was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, this version is excluded from selection even if its effective dates would otherwise include a given time.

models.name: shopping_mall_risk_rules
models.description:
Configuration of risk evaluation rules used by the risk engine to flag suspicious activity, high-risk orders, or risky accounts.

Each risk rule defines a scope (such as account, order, payment, or seller), severity, and a JSON-encoded expression or parameter set that determines how the rule is evaluated.

Rules can be enabled or disabled without deletion and are versioned by creating new rows with different effective date ranges when logic changes. Risk cases and events in other components reference these rules to explain why specific actions were taken.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the risk rule.

plainFields.name: rule_code
plainFields.description:
Stable business identifier for the risk rule, such as "high_refund_rate", "multiple_failed_logins", or "suspicious_address_mismatch".
Used by risk services and reporting.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description:
Human-readable name of the risk rule.
Displayed in admin risk dashboards and configuration tools.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description:
Scope in which this rule operates.
Examples include "account", "order", "payment", "seller", or "session".
Determines what kind of entity the rule evaluates.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description:
Business severity level for this rule.
Examples include "low", "medium", "high", or "critical".
Used to prioritize alerts and responses.

plainFields.name: expression_json
plainFields.description:
JSON-encoded representation of the rule logic or parameters.
May contain conditions, thresholds, and window definitions that the risk engine interprets.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed explanation of what this rule detects and recommended remediation actions.

plainFields.name: is_enabled
plainFields.description:
Flag indicating whether this rule is currently active in risk evaluation.
Disabled rules are preserved but ignored by the runtime engine.

plainFields.name: applies_to_countries
plainFields.description:
Optional JSON-encoded array of country codes where this rule is applicable.
Null means the rule is global.
Used for region-specific risk tuning.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description:
Timestamp from which this risk rule becomes effective.
Null means effective immediately on creation or enablement.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description:
Timestamp after which this risk rule is no longer considered.
Null means no scheduled expiry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this risk rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this risk rule was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp.
When set, the rule is logically retired and should not be used in new evaluations even if its date range is current.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts for the shoppingMall marketplace.

Represents end-user buyers who can register, authenticate, manage addresses, maintain carts and wishlists, place orders, and write reviews. Each row is an identity principal with its own credentials and status lifecycle such as active, suspended, or blocked.

Profiles, addresses, sessions, orders, reviews, and risk flags all reference this table to enforce ownership and authorization boundaries. Historical behavior such as orders or reviews remains even if the account is soft-deleted or suspended.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a customer account across the platform.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the primary login identifier for the customer and for account-related communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed representation of the customer’s authentication secret. Plain text passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business status of the customer account, such as active, suspended, or blocked. Drives permission enforcement at login and during operations.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer’s email address has been verified through the configured verification flow.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login for this customer, or null if the customer has never logged in successfully.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the account is considered logically removed while historical references remain.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for customer accounts.

Represents individual authenticated sessions created when a customer logs in successfully. Each session captures connection context such as IP, href, and referrer, and its temporal lifecycle from creation to expiry.

Sessions are used for audit trails and for associating user activity with specific login events. Sessions are not directly managed by end users; they are managed via authentication flows and cleanup processes.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a customer session instance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer that owns this authenticated session. {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the customer established this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL (href) that the customer used when establishing the session, used for context and security auditing.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL observed when the session was created, used for risk analysis and marketing attribution.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created after successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was explicitly terminated or expired due to inactivity or policy, or null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts on the shoppingMall platform.

Represents merchants or business entities that can onboard, manage their catalog, adjust inventory, and fulfill orders. Each seller has its own login, lifecycle status, and linkage to seller profiles, warehouses, and financial records in other components.

The table is the root identity for all seller-related operations and is referenced by products, SKUs, earnings, payouts, and risk evaluation entities.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a seller account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique business contact email used for seller login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed seller password used for authentication into the seller portal.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the seller account, such as pending_review, active, suspended, or terminated.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the seller’s contact email has been successfully verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the seller account, or null if the account is still logically present.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for seller accounts.

Stores individual login sessions created when a seller successfully authenticates into the seller portal. Each session records the owning seller, basic connection metadata, and its temporal validity.

These records support security investigation, abuse detection, and operational analytics on seller access behavior.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a seller session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller that owns this authenticated session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the seller established this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL used when establishing the session, captured for context and risk analysis.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at session creation time for attribution and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller session was created after successful login.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or expired, or null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator accounts for the shoppingMall platform.

Represents internal staff users who operate the marketplace, perform governance, moderation, and configuration tasks. Each admin has a unique login identity and may be associated with roles and permissions defined in other components.

Admin actions must be auditable, so this entity is referenced by audit logs, risk cases, and many governance records.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies an admin account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used as the primary login for the admin account.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for admin authentication. May be supplemented by stronger mechanisms such as multi-step verification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business status of the admin, for example active, suspended, or disabled.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the admin’s email has been verified or otherwise assured as valid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the admin account, or null when still logically active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for admin accounts.

Tracks every authenticated admin session, capturing when and from where admins access the system. This is critical for governance, auditability, and detection of potential internal misuse.

These records are managed exclusively by the authentication subsystem and are not directly edited by admins themselves.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies an admin session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account that owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin initiated the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL used when the session was created, useful for audit and troubleshooting.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at the time of login, used for analyzing access paths and potential abuse.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session was created after successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or expired, or null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_guestusers
models.description:
Logical identities for guest users of the shoppingMall platform.

Represents unauthenticated visitors who may still own transient business data such as temporary carts or wishlists before converting to registered customers. Each guestuser row provides a stable identifier for analytics, risk analysis, and possible later conversion.

Guest users do not authenticate with passwords, but may be linked to devices or sessions for behavioral tracking under privacy rules.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a guest user identity.

plainFields.name: external_reference
plainFields.description: Optional external or device-based reference used to correlate guest sessions, such as a cookie or device identifier, stored in a privacy-aware way.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest user identity was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest user record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, used when the guest record is no longer needed but historic relations must remain.

models.name: shopping_mall_guestuser_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guest users.

Captures browsing sessions for unauthenticated visitors. These sessions are used to manage temporary carts or wishlists and to analyze pre-registration behavior, while respecting privacy and security policies.

Guest sessions follow the same structural pattern as customer, seller, and admin sessions but do not link to any authenticated credentials.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a guest user session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Guest user that owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_guestusers}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed for the guest session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL that initiated the guest session, used as browsing context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at the time the guest session started.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was first created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session expired or was terminated.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_profiles
models.description:
Extended profile information for customers.

Stores non-authentication attributes for customers such as display name and optional demographic fields. This separation allows profile data to evolve independently from authentication credentials and to be governed differently.

A customer has at most one profile, enforced via a unique constraint on the foreign key. Orders, reviews, and analytics components may reference profile data for personalization and reporting.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a customer profile.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
