Each record defines a permissible value for a {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes} entry, such as "Red" for color or "XL" for size. These values are referenced by {@link shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values} when binding values to specific SKUs.

The table is primary because attribute values can be managed independently within each product and are reused across many SKUs, making them a stable business concept.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the product attribute value. {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: Product attribute that this value belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Canonical representation of the attribute value, for example Red or XL.

plainFields.name: display_value
plainFields.description: Human-readable display value for the attribute value, which may differ slightly from the canonical form.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numeric ordering value controlling the order of possible values in selection UIs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_skus
models.description:
Stock keeping units representing concrete sellable variants of products.

Each SKU belongs to exactly one {@link shopping_mall_products} record and describes a specific combination of attribute values, its own price and inventory quantity. It is the atomic unit for cart, order, inventory, and eligibility logic across the platform.

This table stores the authoritative current inventory quantity and SKU-level status. Detailed adjustment history is kept in inventory adjustment tables in the SellerPortal domain. Attribute combinations are modeled via {@link shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values}, and optional external identifiers via {@link shopping_mall_sku_external_ids}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the SKU. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this SKU belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_inventory_state_id
foreignFields.description: Current inventory state of the SKU describing availability semantics. {@link shopping_mall_sku_inventory_states.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business-level SKU code unique per product or seller, used in operations and integrations.

plainFields.name: barcode
plainFields.description: Optional barcode or similar identifier used for physical warehouse operations.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the SKU such as draft, active, inactive, discontinued, or blocked_by_admin.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Current selling price for this SKU in the platform base currency.

plainFields.name: original_price
plainFields.description: Optional reference or list price used for showing discount information.

plainFields.name: inventory_quantity
plainFields.description: Authoritative current on-hand inventory quantity for this SKU, not including external reservations.

plainFields.name: low_stock_threshold
plainFields.description: Optional threshold at or below which the SKU is considered low stock for seller alerts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the SKU was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values
models.description:
Junction table binding attribute values to specific SKUs, defining variant combinations.

Each record links a {@link shopping_mall_skus} entry to a {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values} entry for the parent product. The complete set of rows for a SKU describes its selected values across all variant dimensions and non-variant attributes.

This table is subsidiary because it exists purely to model the many-to-many relationship between SKUs and attribute values and is always managed through product and SKU flows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the SKU-attribute-value link. {@link shopping_mall_sku_attribute_values.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU that uses the attribute value. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_value_id
foreignFields.description: Attribute value applied to the SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU attribute value link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU attribute value link was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU attribute value link was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_external_ids
models.description:
External system identifiers associated with SKUs for integrations.

Each record stores an identifier used by an external system, such as a warehouse management system, marketplace integration, or barcode registry, and links it to a {@link shopping_mall_skus} entry.

The table is subsidiary because these identifiers are managed in the context of a SKU and are not independently searchable by business users outside of integration and operations tooling.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the SKU external identifier. {@link shopping_mall_sku_external_ids.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU that this external identifier refers to. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: system_code
plainFields.description: Code identifying the external system, such as WMS, ERP, or marketplace code.

plainFields.name: external_id
plainFields.description: Identifier value used by the external system for this SKU.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this external identifier was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this external identifier was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this external identifier was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_inventory_states
models.description:
Reference table defining inventory state semantics used by SKUs.

Each entry represents a business-level inventory state such as in_stock, out_of_stock, preorder, or discontinued. {@link shopping_mall_skus} records reference this table to describe how inventory quantities should be interpreted in cart and checkout flows.

The table is a primary entity because the set of inventory states is centrally configured and reused across all SKUs and is important for reporting and rule configuration.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the SKU inventory state. {@link shopping_mall_sku_inventory_states.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code for the inventory state such as in_stock or preorder.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the inventory state shown in admin tools.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description explaining how this inventory state behaves in catalog and checkout flows.

plainFields.name: is_purchasable
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether SKUs in this state are eligible to be added to carts and orders.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory state was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory state was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory state was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_catalog_visibility_rules
models.description:
Catalog visibility rules that control which products or SKUs are visible to which actors under what conditions.

Each row represents a rule created typically by admins to hide or show subsets of the catalog based on actor type, region, lifecycle status, or configuration flags. Rules can target an entire catalog, a specific seller, a product, or a SKU by using foreign keys where applicable.

This is a primary table because visibility rules are managed and audited as first-class business entities and influence catalog behavior across multiple components.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the catalog visibility rule. {@link shopping_mall_catalog_visibility_rules.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created this visibility rule. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Optional seller that this rule applies to, if the rule is seller-scoped. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Optional product that this rule applies to, if the rule is product-specific. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Optional SKU that this rule applies to, if the rule is SKU-specific. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: rule_type
plainFields.description: Type of the rule such as hide, show_only_to_registered, or region_restricted.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Optional actor type the rule targets, for example guestUser, customer, seller, or admin.

plainFields.name: region_code
plainFields.description: Optional region or market code used when the rule is region-specific.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this visibility rule is currently active.

plainFields.name: starts_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp from which the rule becomes effective.

plainFields.name: ends_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp after which the rule no longer applies.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable explanation of why this rule exists, useful for governance and audit views.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the visibility rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the visibility rule was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the visibility rule was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_catalog_search_index_entries
models.description:
Denormalized search index entries for products and SKUs used to accelerate catalog search.

Each record aggregates search-relevant fields such as titles, summaries, tags, and attribute text for a single target entity, typically a {@link shopping_mall_products} or {@link shopping_mall_skus} record. The index supports full-text search and ranking without touching all normalized tables at query time.

Although it stores derived data, it is modeled as a regular table rather than an mv_ view to allow flexible rebuilding strategies. It is subsidiary because it is populated and maintained by background processes and never edited directly by business users.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the catalog search index entry. {@link shopping_mall_catalog_search_index_entries.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this index entry refers to, if the entry is product-scoped. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU that this index entry refers to, if the entry is SKU-scoped. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: locale
plainFields.description: Locale of the indexed text, such as en-US or ko-KR.

plainFields.name: search_text
plainFields.description: Concatenated and normalized text used for full-text search, including titles, summaries, tags, and attribute labels.

plainFields.name: boost_score
plainFields.description: Precomputed numeric boost used to influence ranking, for example based on popularity or recency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this index entry was created or last rebuilt.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this index entry metadata was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this index entry was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_catalog_block_reasons
models.description:
Reference table describing reasons why catalog entities are blocked or removed from sale.

Each record defines a reusable business-level reason such as policy_violation, legal_request, counterfeit_suspected, or safety_issue. These reasons can be referenced by governance and moderation components when blocking products or SKUs via visibility rules or other mechanisms.

The table is a primary entity because block reasons are centrally configured, audited, and reused across many enforcement actions and reports.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the catalog block reason. {@link shopping_mall_catalog_block_reasons.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code representing the block reason, such as policy_violation or legal_request.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the block reason displayed in admin tools.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of when this block reason should be used.

plainFields.name: severity_level
plainFields.description: Business-level severity classification such as low, medium, or high used for risk reporting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the block reason was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the block reason was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the block reason was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Shopping cart header entities for both guest users and authenticated customers.

Each cart represents a collection of items (SKUs) that a user intends to purchase but has not yet converted into an order. A cart can belong to either a guestUser or a customer actor, identified by the actor_type field and corresponding foreign key.

Carts track lifecycle state through a flexible status string (for example active, converted_to_order, merged, abandoned) and store timestamps for creation, update, soft deletion, and the last time full validation was executed.

Carts are linked to {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} for line items and {@link shopping_mall_cart_merge_events} for guest-to-customer merge history. They reference external actor models {@link shopping_mall_customers} and {@link shopping_mall_guestusers}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owning authenticated customer when actor_type is "customer". {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Owning guest user when actor_type is "guestuser". {@link shopping_mall_guestusers.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor that owns the cart. Expected business values include "guestuser" and "customer" and must be consistent with which foreign key is populated.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the cart such as "active", "converted_to_order", "merged", or "abandoned". Used by background jobs and APIs to filter carts.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO currency code representing the pricing currency for items in this cart. All monetary values for cart items should be expressed in this currency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last updated, including item changes or status transitions.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the cart is considered logically removed but retained for analytics and audit.

plainFields.name: last_validated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart and its items were last fully validated for availability, pricing, and other business rules.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Line items associated with shopping carts.

Each cart item represents a specific SKU and quantity that a user has added to a cart. Items reference the owning cart header and the SKU from the product catalog.

Cart items store quantity and unit price snapshots in the cart currency, enabling order creation to capture prices at the time of checkout. They also include lightweight validation status fields for quick checks, with detailed validation history stored in {@link shopping_mall_cart_item_validations}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the cart item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Owning cart header. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU being purchased in this cart item. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Requested quantity of the SKU in this cart item. Must be a positive integer and is revalidated against inventory and purchase limits.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Snapshot unit price of the SKU in the cart currency at the time it was last recalculated.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO currency code for the unit_price. Should match the currency_code of the owning cart.

plainFields.name: last_validation_status
plainFields.description: Result of the most recent lightweight validation for this item such as "ok", "out_of_stock", or "price_changed". Detailed history is kept in cart item validations.

plainFields.name: last_validation_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when last_validation_status was updated.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was first added to the cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, this item is logically removed from the cart while preserving historical data for analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_item_validations
models.description:
Historical validation records for individual cart items.

Each record captures the result of a validation pass against a specific cart item, such as when a user adds an item, opens the cart, or begins checkout. It stores the type of validation, the outcome status, optional descriptive messages, and any quantity adjustments.

These records provide an audit trail that supports debugging, analytics on cart friction, and compliance needs. They supplement the lightweight status maintained directly on {@link shopping_mall_cart_items}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the validation record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_item_id
foreignFields.description: Target cart item that was validated. {@link shopping_mall_cart_items.id}.

plainFields.name: validation_type
plainFields.description: Business type of validation such as "add_to_cart", "cart_view", or "checkout". Used for analytics and rule-specific behavior.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Outcome of the validation such as "success", "error", or "adjusted" indicating whether the item remains valid, was rejected, or underwent corrections.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation or error message describing the validation result. Useful for customer-facing messaging and support analysis.

plainFields.name: previous_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity before any adjustment applied by this validation. Null when not applicable.

plainFields.name: validated_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity after validation and any applied adjustment. Null when validation did not change quantity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the validation record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_merge_events
models.description:
Audit records for guest-to-customer or cart-to-cart merge operations.

When a guestUser authenticates and the system merges a temporary cart into an existing customer cart, each merge is recorded in this table. The record includes references to source and target actors and carts, counts of merged and dropped items, and a reason field for business diagnostics.

These events support audit trails, debugging of merge logic, and analytics around how often and how effectively carts are preserved when users log in. They relate to {@link shopping_mall_carts} and to external actor models {@link shopping_mall_customers} and {@link shopping_mall_guestusers}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the merge event.

foreignFields.name: source_shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Source guest user whose temporary cart was merged. {@link shopping_mall_guestusers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Target customer who received merged cart contents. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: source_shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Source cart whose items were merged. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Target cart that absorbed items from the source cart. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

plainFields.name: source_actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of the source actor, typically "guestuser". Helps interpret which foreign keys are expected to be populated.

plainFields.name: target_actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of the target actor, typically "customer". Helps interpret which foreign keys are expected to be populated.

plainFields.name: merged_item_count
plainFields.description: Number of items successfully merged from the source cart into the target cart.

plainFields.name: dropped_item_count
plainFields.description: Number of items that could not be merged due to validation failures such as discontinued SKUs or policy violations.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional business reason or additional context for the merge, such as policy or strategy name used for conflict resolution.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the merge event occurred.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer-owned wishlists for saving products of interest.

Each wishlist belongs to a single authenticated customer and contains one or more items referencing products and optionally SKUs. Customers can maintain multiple named wishlists or a single default list depending on business configuration.

Wishlists support soft deletion and a flexible status string so they can be archived or hidden while preserving their contents for analytics. Related items are stored in {@link shopping_mall_wishlist_items}, and merge events from guest wishlists are stored in {@link shopping_mall_wishlist_merge_events}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the wishlist.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the wishlist such as "Default", "Gifts", or "Later".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description or notes about the purpose of this wishlist.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this is the customer's default wishlist used when no specific list is chosen.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business status of the wishlist such as "active" or "archived". Controls whether it is shown in standard customer flows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the wishlist is logically removed from customer flows but may be retained for analytics.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Items contained in customer wishlists.

Each record links a wishlist to a specific product and optionally a specific SKU when the customer saved a particular variant. It maintains the order in which items were added and supports soft deletion for audit and analytics.

Wishlist items allow marketing and analytics teams to query across all lists for demand signals, while customers manage their lists through application features. The table references {@link shopping_mall_wishlists}, {@link shopping_mall_products}, and {@link shopping_mall_skus}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier of the wishlist item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Owning wishlist that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that the customer saved to the wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Optional specific SKU variant saved to the wishlist when the customer selected a concrete option. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Relative ordering position of the item within the wishlist. Lower values are displayed earlier.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the item is logically removed from the wishlist but retained for historical analysis.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_merge_events
models.description:
Audit records for guest-to-customer wishlist merge operations.

When a guestUser signs in and the system merges a temporary wishlist into a customer's existing wishlists, each merge operation is recorded here. Records capture source and target actors and wishlists, counts of merged and dropped items, and a free-form reason.

These events are important for understanding how well wishlist data is preserved across sessions and devices and for diagnosing merge policies. They relate to {@link shopping_mall_wishlists}, {@link shopping_mall_customers}, and {@link shopping_mall_guestusers}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the wishlist merge event.

foreignFields.name: source_shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description: Source guest user whose temporary wishlist was merged. {@link shopping_mall_guestusers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Target customer who received the merged wishlist items. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: source_shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Source wishlist whose items were merged. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Target wishlist that absorbed items from the source wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

plainFields.name: source_actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of the source actor, typically "guestuser". Indicates which actor foreign key should be populated.

plainFields.name: target_actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of the target actor, typically "customer". Indicates which actor foreign key should be populated.

plainFields.name: merged_item_count
plainFields.description: Number of wishlist items successfully merged from the source into the target wishlist.

plainFields.name: dropped_item_count
plainFields.description: Number of wishlist items that could not be merged due to product visibility, policy, or duplication rules.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional textual reason or context for the merge, such as merge policy name or conflict resolution notes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist merge event occurred.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Customer-facing order headers representing confirmed checkouts.

Each record captures the core business identity and high-level lifecycle of an order, including ownership, association to the originating cart, monetary summary, and the current status for efficient querying.

Detailed monetary breakdowns, historical price changes, and status timelines are normalized into supporting tables such as {@link shopping_mall_order_price_snapshots} and {@link shopping_mall_order_status_histories}.

Orders are the parent for {@link shopping_mall_order_items} and {@link shopping_mall_shipments}, enabling multi-seller and multi-shipment scenarios while preserving a single customer-visible order identifier.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order record. Globally unique identifier for this order.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description:
Optional reference to the authenticated customer who owns this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

Null when the order is associated with a guest user account instead of a registered customer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_guestuser_id
foreignFields.description:
Optional reference to a guest user entity when the order was placed without full customer registration. {@link shopping_mall_guestusers.id}.

Exactly one of shopping_mall_customer_id or shopping_mall_guestuser_id is expected to be non-null at business level.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the cart from which this order was created, if such a cart existed. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

Null for orders created through flows that do not use a persistent cart.

plainFields.name: order_code
plainFields.description:
Business-facing order code shown to customers in communications and order history.

Typically a human-friendly identifier such as a formatted sequence; must be unique per platform.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for all monetary values in this order (for example "USD" or "KRW").

plainFields.name: current_status
plainFields.description:
Current high-level business status of the order.

Examples include: "awaiting_payment", "payment_confirmed", "preparing_shipment", "shipped", "delivered", "cancelled", "refunded".

Detailed history of transitions is stored in {@link shopping_mall_order_status_histories}.

plainFields.name: item_count
plainFields.description:
Total count of order line items at the time of order confirmation.

This is a denormalized convenience value used for quick listing and does not replace the authoritative data in {@link shopping_mall_order_items}.

plainFields.name: grand_total_amount
plainFields.description:
Total amount charged to the customer for this order in the order currency.

This includes item subtotals, discounts, shipping fees, surcharges, and taxes according to business rules at the time of confirmation.

plainFields.name: placed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer confirmed checkout and the order record was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order row was first persisted in the database.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order row was last updated, including status or summary updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp for this order.

Null for active orders; set when an order is logically removed from normal views while retained for audit and compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual order line items representing purchased SKUs within an order.

Each row binds a product SKU to an order with a quantity and monetary amounts captured at the time of order confirmation.

Seller ownership for each line is further normalized into {@link shopping_mall_order_item_sellers} so that multi-seller orders can be settled and fulfilled correctly.

The line data is immutable after confirmation except for fields related to cancellations or adjustments that are handled in payment and refund domains.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order item row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent order that owns this line item. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the SKU being purchased on this line. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

The SKU snapshot at order time is preserved via external snapshot mechanisms; this FK ensures linkage to the catalog entity.

plainFields.name: line_number
plainFields.description:
Sequential position of this line item within the order, starting from 1.

Used to provide stable ordering in order detail views.

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description:
Snapshot of the product name at the time of order.

This prevents later catalog changes from altering historical order presentations.

plainFields.name: sku_name
plainFields.description:
Snapshot of the SKU variant title or descriptive label at the time of order.

Provides quick understanding of the selected variant without extra joins.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description:
Quantity of the SKU purchased on this line.

Must be a positive integer.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Per-unit selling price for this SKU at order time in the order currency, before line-level discounts.

plainFields.name: line_subtotal
plainFields.description:
Subtotal for this line before discounts, calculated as quantity × unit_price.

Stored as a raw value for audit and quick aggregation.

plainFields.name: line_discount_amount
plainFields.description:
Total discount amount applied to this line, including seller-funded and platform-funded discounts.

A non-negative monetary value.

plainFields.name: line_total
plainFields.description:
Final payable amount for this line after discounts but before order-level fees and taxes.

This value is part of the order monetary snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item row was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_sellers
models.description:
Mapping table linking order items to their owning sellers in multi-seller orders.

Each row associates a line item in {@link shopping_mall_order_items} with a single seller from {@link shopping_mall_sellers}, enabling seller-specific order views, fulfillment, and earnings calculations.

The table enforces a 1:1 relationship between an order line and its seller mapping while allowing multiple sellers per order across different lines.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order item seller mapping row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the order item that this mapping describes. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

Enforced unique to ensure one seller mapping per order line.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller responsible for supplying the SKU on this order line. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this mapping row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this mapping row was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_price_snapshots
models.description:
Monetary snapshot records capturing decomposed price components per order.

Each snapshot stores item subtotals, discounts, shipping fees, surcharges, taxes, and total payable amounts at a particular point in the order lifecycle.

Snapshots support audit, reporting, and reconciliation of order-level monetary values independently from payment attempts and refunds, which are modeled in dedicated payment components.

Multiple snapshots can exist per order, for example initial quote versus final charged amount, with the application treating the latest snapshot as authoritative for most business queries.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order price snapshot row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order whose monetary state this snapshot describes. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: item_subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Sum of item-level subtotals before discounts for this order at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: item_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount amount applied at line level across all items, including seller and platform funded discounts.

plainFields.name: order_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount amount applied at order level (for example coupon or campaign discounts) at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: shipping_fee_amount
plainFields.description:
Total shipping fee amount charged to the customer in this snapshot.

May be zero when free shipping promotions apply.

plainFields.name: payment_surcharge_amount
plainFields.description:
Total payment method surcharge charged to the customer in this snapshot, if any.

Represents platform-owned or pass-through fees depending on configuration.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description:
Total tax amount calculated for the order at the time of snapshot.

May be zero for tax-exempt jurisdictions or orders.

plainFields.name: grand_total_amount
plainFields.description:
Total amount to be charged to the customer for this snapshot.

Equals item_subtotal_amount minus discounts plus shipping_fee_amount, surcharges, and taxes.

plainFields.name: is_final
plainFields.description:
Flag indicating whether this snapshot represents the final confirmed monetary state for the order.

Business logic treats the latest snapshot with is_final = true as authoritative for reporting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot row was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_histories
models.description:
Historical records of order status transitions over time.

Each row captures a change in the high-level business status of an order, including when it happened, optional reason, and which actor type initiated the transition.

This model enables detailed audit trails for order lifecycle analysis, compliance, and customer support without overloading the main {@link shopping_mall_orders} table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order status history row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order whose status changed. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the customer who triggered this status change, when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the seller who triggered this status change, when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the admin who triggered this status change, when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: from_status
plainFields.description:
Previous status value before this transition.

Null when this is the initial status for the order.

plainFields.name: to_status
plainFields.description:
New status value applied to the order as a result of this transition.

Values mirror those used in shopping_mall_orders.current_status.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional machine-readable reason code for the status change, such as "payment_confirmed", "customer_cancelled", or "system_timeout".

plainFields.name: reason_detail
plainFields.description:
Optional human-readable explanation of why this status change occurred.

Useful for support and audit reviews.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change took effect from a business perspective.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history row was persisted.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Shipment headers representing fulfillment units derived from orders.

Each shipment is associated with a single seller and covers a subset of items from a customer order, potentially routed to a specific destination.

The model holds high-level shipping status, carrier and tracking details, and links to the chosen shipping method and shipping address snapshot.

Detailed shipment item allocations and event timelines are modeled in {@link shopping_mall_shipment_items} and {@link shopping_mall_shipment_events}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shipment record.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer order that this shipment fulfills. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller responsible for shipping the items in this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_address_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipping address snapshot used for this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_addresses.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_method_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipping method record chosen for this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: shipment_code
plainFields.description:
Business-facing shipment code used for seller and customer communication.

Often derived from order code with a suffix or separate sequence.

plainFields.name: shipping_status
plainFields.description:
Current shipping status for this shipment.

Examples include: "pending", "preparing", "ready_for_pickup", "shipped", "in_transit", "out_for_delivery", "delivered", "delivery_failed", "returned", "cancelled".

Detailed event history is stored in {@link shopping_mall_shipment_events}.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description:
Name of the carrier handling this shipment, such as a courier company.

Null when shipment has not yet been assigned to a carrier.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description:
Tracking identifier assigned by the carrier for this shipment.

Null when tracking is not yet available or not supported.

plainFields.name: expected_ship_date
plainFields.description:
Optional date-time when the shipment is expected to leave the seller or warehouse.

Used for SLA tracking and customer expectations.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment first entered the carrier network or was marked as shipped.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was confirmed delivered to the customer, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this shipment, used when hiding it from normal views while retaining it for historical purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_items
models.description:
Association table binding shipments to the specific order items and SKUs they contain.

Each row represents a quantity of a particular order item allocated to a shipment, enabling partial shipments, backorders, and complex fulfillment scenarios across multiple sellers or warehouses.

The table ensures that shipped quantities can be reconciled against ordered quantities without duplicating catalog or pricing information.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shipment item row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipment that includes this item. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item being shipped. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU for this shipment item, mirroring the SKU used on the order line. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description:
Quantity of the order item allocated to this shipment.

Must be a positive integer and not exceed the remaining unshipped quantity for the corresponding order item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment item row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment item row was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_events
models.description:
Event log entries representing the detailed shipping and tracking timeline for a shipment.

Each row captures a discrete event such as status updates from the carrier, internal state transitions, or manual admin adjustments.

These records provide a fine-grained view of shipment progress for customer tracking, support investigations, and SLA monitoring, complementing the high-level shipping_status field on {@link shopping_mall_shipments}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shipment event row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipment whose timeline this event belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Machine-readable type of event, such as "status_change", "carrier_scan", "address_correction", or "manual_override".

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Optional shipping status value associated with this event, mirroring shipping_status values on the parent shipment.

Null when the event does not represent a status change.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Optional human-readable description providing more detail about the event.

This text can be shown in customer-facing tracking views or internal tools.

plainFields.name: event_time
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the event occurred from a business perspective.

May come from carrier data or internal system time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this event row was persisted.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_addresses
models.description:
Snapshot records of shipping addresses used for orders and shipments.

Each row stores the recipient and address details that were effective at the time of order confirmation or shipment creation, ensuring that later changes to customer address book entries do not affect historical records.

Shipments reference these snapshots via {@link shopping_mall_shipments}, and orders can also use them for order-level address reporting.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shipping address snapshot row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order that uses this shipping address snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_address_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description:
Optional reference to the underlying customer address snapshot from the identity domain. {@link shopping_mall_customer_address_snapshots.id}.

Null when the shipping address was entered ad-hoc at checkout without being stored as a reusable customer address.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the person or entity that should receive the shipment as captured at checkout.

plainFields.name: line1
plainFields.description: First line of the street address or primary address information.

plainFields.name: line2
plainFields.description: Second line of the street address, such as apartment, suite, or building information.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality component of the shipping address.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the destination country.

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Region, state, or province information, if applicable to the country.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number associated with the shipping address, used by carriers and support.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping address snapshot row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping address snapshot row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp for this snapshot.

Used when the address snapshot must be hidden from most queries but retained for legal or audit purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_methods
models.description:
Records representing shipping methods selected on orders and shipments.

Each row describes a named shipping method in business terms at the time of selection, including a code and human-readable label, plus optional metadata about service level.

Orders and shipments reference these records to understand which service (for example standard or express) was used without directly depending on external configuration tables that may change over time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shipping method record.

plainFields.name: method_code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable shipping method code used internally, such as "standard", "express", or carrier-specific identifiers.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable shipping method name shown to customers and sellers, such as "Standard Shipping" or "Express Courier".

plainFields.name: service_level_description
plainFields.description: Optional description of service level expectations, such as estimated delivery windows or special handling notes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping method record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping method record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_customer_contacts
models.description:
Snapshot records of customer contact information used for orders.

Each row stores name, email, and phone details that were current at the time of order placement, ensuring that later profile changes do not affect historical communication records.

The snapshot is used for order notifications, customer support, and compliance with communication audit requirements, and is linked from {@link shopping_mall_orders}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the order customer contact snapshot row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description:
Reference to the order whose contact information this snapshot holds. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

Enforced as unique so that each order has at most one primary contact snapshot.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description:
Optional reference to the customer account associated with this contact snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

Null when the order was placed by a guest or when contact information does not map cleanly to a single customer account.

plainFields.name: contact_name
plainFields.description: Customer name used for order communications at the time of placement.

plainFields.name: contact_email
plainFields.description: Email address used for order confirmations and notifications at the time of placement.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Optional phone number used for order-related communication at the time of placement.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order customer contact snapshot row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order customer contact snapshot row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Soft deletion timestamp for this snapshot.

Used when contact data must be hidden while retaining the order record for reporting or legal reasons.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_methods
models.description:
Configured payment methods that customers can use during checkout.

Each row represents a conceptual payment method, such as a card processor, bank transfer, wallet, or COD, as seen by business logic. Methods are referenced by order payments to determine which rails were used for a payment.

Business rules and availability (region, currency, status) are stored here so that payment selection during checkout can be validated and audited over time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business identifier for the payment method (e.g., "card", "bank_transfer"). Used in configuration and references from other tables.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the payment method shown in backoffice and possibly to customers (for example "Credit Card", "Bank Transfer").

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description of the payment method for admin reference or customer hints.

plainFields.name: provider_type
plainFields.description: High-level provider type or gateway family (for example "card_processor", "bank_gateway", "wallet", "cod").

plainFields.name: allowed_currencies
plainFields.description: Optional serialized list or expression of allowed order currencies for this method (for example comma-separated ISO 4217 codes).

plainFields.name: allowed_countries
plainFields.description: Optional serialized list or expression of allowed customer shipping or billing countries for this method (for example comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).

plainFields.name: min_amount
plainFields.description: Optional minimum payable amount for using this method, in the order currency.

plainFields.name: max_amount
plainFields.description: Optional maximum payable amount for using this method, in the order currency.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the payment method at business level (for example "active", "disabled"). Determines whether it may be chosen at checkout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_surcharges
models.description:
Payment method surcharge and fee configuration.

Each row defines fee behavior for a particular payment method under some business scope, such as a specific region, currency, or order amount range. These rows allow calculation of customer-facing surcharges and platform-owned or pass-through fees per payment method.

This table is subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods} and is not managed independently by end users.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method that this surcharge configuration belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: scope_code
plainFields.description: Optional business scope identifier for this surcharge (for example a region code, channel code, or customer segment).

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code for which this surcharge configuration applies. If null, applies to all currencies of the parent method.

plainFields.name: min_order_amount
plainFields.description: Optional minimum order amount for which this surcharge configuration is valid.

plainFields.name: max_order_amount
plainFields.description: Optional maximum order amount for which this surcharge configuration is valid.

plainFields.name: fixed_fee_amount
plainFields.description: Optional fixed fee amount added when this payment method is used and this rule applies.

plainFields.name: percentage_fee_rate
plainFields.description: Optional percentage fee rate applied to the payable amount when this rule applies (for example 2.9 for 2.9%).

plainFields.name: is_platform_revenue
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this surcharge is owned by the platform (true) or pass-through to external parties such as carriers or gateways (false).

plainFields.name: refundable_policy
plainFields.description: Optional policy string explaining how this surcharge behaves in refunds (for example "refundable", "non_refundable", or a more complex expression).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this surcharge rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this surcharge rule was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payments
models.description:
Logical payments associated with customer orders.

Each row represents a payment at the business level for one order, which may be fully or partially covered by one or more attempts or split payments. The row holds the payable amount, method, and high-level status used to drive order payment lifecycle.

Refunds, chargebacks, and reconciliation events reference this entity to adjust and audit financial outcomes over time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this logical payment belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns the order and thus the payment. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method used for this payment from the platform perspective. {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_sequence
plainFields.description: Sequence number of this payment within the order, starting from 1. Allows multiple payments per order (partial or split payments).

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which this payment is denominated.

plainFields.name: payable_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that should be paid for this payment in currency_code, including items, taxes, and customer-facing fees that belong to this payment.

plainFields.name: captured_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has actually been captured or otherwise confirmed as paid so far for this payment.

plainFields.name: refunded_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has been refunded for this payment across all completed refunds.

plainFields.name: chargeback_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount that has been chargebacked for this payment across all chargebacks.

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Business status for this payment (for example "pending", "paid", "partially_refunded", "refunded", "chargeback", "cancelled"). Drives order eligibility to ship and refund.

plainFields.name: provider_status_code
plainFields.description: Optional provider-specific status code summarizing the last known state from the payment gateway.

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Optional reference identifier from the payment provider (for example payment intent id or transaction id) at the payment level.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional serialized metadata for payment, such as structured JSON storing provider or internal diagnostic information.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_attempts
models.description:
Concrete payment attempts for a logical order payment.

Each row represents one technical attempt to pay the amount indicated by the parent payment, such as a card charge attempt or bank transfer initiation. Multiple attempts may exist for the same business payment due to retries or switching methods, depending on policy.

Attempts are subsidiary and are mainly used for audit, troubleshooting, and risk analysis rather than independent management.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent logical order payment that this attempt belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: Payment method actually used in this attempt (could differ from the main payment configuration in exceptional flows). {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id}.

plainFields.name: attempt_sequence
plainFields.description: Sequence number of this attempt for the given payment, starting from 1. Used to order attempts chronologically or by retry count.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of this attempt (for example "pending", "success", "failed", "error", "expired").

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount that this attempt tried to authorize or capture, denominated in the payment currency.

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Attempt-level reference from the payment provider (for example transaction id or intent id).

plainFields.name: failure_code
plainFields.description: Optional failure or error code reported by the payment provider for this attempt.

plainFields.name: failure_message
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable message explaining why the attempt failed or errored, suitable for internal support analysis.

plainFields.name: raw_response
plainFields.description: Optional serialized raw response or payload received from the payment provider for this attempt for debugging and audits.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attempt record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attempt record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_status_histories
models.description:
Historical status changes for order payments.

Each row records a transition of business_status and optionally provider_status_code for a particular payment. This provides an append-only audit trail showing how payment state evolved over time and which process or actor triggered each change.

It is subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_order_payments} and used mainly for audit, risk, and debugging purposes.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Payment whose status changed. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional admin who manually changed the status, if the transition was admin-driven. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_business_status
plainFields.description: Previous business_status value before this change. Null if this is the first recorded status.

plainFields.name: new_business_status
plainFields.description: New business_status value after this change.

plainFields.name: previous_provider_status_code
plainFields.description: Previous provider_status_code before this change, if any.

plainFields.name: new_provider_status_code
plainFields.description: New provider_status_code after this change, if any.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional structured code describing why the status change occurred (for example "payment_confirmed", "refund_completed", "manual_override").

plainFields.name: reason_message
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable explanation providing more detail about the status change for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Generally equals created_at for immutable history rows.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_refunds
models.description:
Refund operations executed against payments.

Each row represents a refund transaction at the payment level, covering some portion or all of one order payment. Refunds reference order payments rather than orders directly, aligning financial flows with payment records.

Refund items provide per-line breakdowns, and external provider references allow reconciliation with gateway-side refund transactions.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Payment that this refund operation applies to. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who approved or executed the refund, when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: refund_sequence
plainFields.description: Sequence number of this refund for the given payment, starting from 1. Used to differentiate multiple refunds against the same payment.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code in which this refund is denominated. Usually matches the payment currency.

plainFields.name: requested_amount
plainFields.description: Amount initially requested to be refunded at business level.

plainFields.name: approved_amount

plainFields.name: refunded_amount
plainFields.description: Amount that the payment provider confirms has actually been refunded to the customer.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of this refund (for example "pending", "approved", "rejected", "completed", "failed").

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional structured reason code for the refund, aligned with business-level refund reasons.

plainFields.name: reason_message

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Optional refund transaction reference from the payment provider.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional serialized metadata with provider or internal diagnostic details regarding this refund.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
