models.name: shopping_mall_payment_refund_items
models.description:
Per-order-item breakdown of a refund.

Each row represents a portion of a refund allocated to a particular order item. It supports item-level refund amounts, quantities, and reason codes so that refunds can be analyzed at the SKU or seller level.

This table is subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_payment_refunds} and {@link shopping_mall_order_items}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_refund_id
foreignFields.description: Refund that this item-level breakdown belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_payment_refunds.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item whose charge is being refunded in whole or part. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: refunded_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the order item being refunded. Supports fractional quantities if the platform allows them.

plainFields.name: unit_price_amount
plainFields.description: Unit price amount used as basis for this refund for the item in currency_code of the parent refund.

plainFields.name: line_refund_amount
plainFields.description: Total monetary amount refunded for this order item line within this refund operation.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional item-specific reason code (for example "damaged", "wrong_item", "customer_remorse").

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund item record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_chargebacks
models.description:
Chargeback cases associated with payments.

Each row represents a chargeback event opened by a card issuer, bank, or wallet provider against a specific payment. It captures the disputed amount, status, stages of the dispute, and provider references.

This table enables risk and loss tracking, as well as coordination with order state and seller earnings adjustments.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Payment that this chargeback relates to. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional admin overseeing this chargeback or responsible for manual decisions. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the disputed amount. Usually matches the payment currency.

plainFields.name: disputed_amount
plainFields.description: Amount disputed by the issuer or payment provider.

plainFields.name: chargeback_amount
plainFields.description: Amount that has actually been withdrawn from the platform due to this chargeback, if any.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Provider or scheme-defined chargeback reason code.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business status of the chargeback case (for example "open", "won", "lost", "writing_off").

plainFields.name: stage
plainFields.description: Optional stage indicator for the lifecycle of the chargeback (for example "first_presentment", "pre_arbitration", "arbitration").

plainFields.name: provider_reference
plainFields.description: Chargeback reference identifier from the payment provider, card scheme, or bank network.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional serialized metadata including provider payloads, internal notes, or evidence references.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_reconciliation_events
models.description:
Reconciliation events recorded for payments.

Each row captures a reconciliation finding or adjustment for a payment, such as mismatched amounts between provider and internal records, late notifications, or manual corrections.

These events are subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_order_payments} and help auditors and operations track how discrepancies were detected and resolved.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Payment that this reconciliation event concerns. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional admin who created or resolved this reconciliation event. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of reconciliation event (for example "amount_mismatch", "late_capture", "provider_report_only").

plainFields.name: provider_amount
plainFields.description: Amount reported by the provider when this event was detected, if applicable.

plainFields.name: internal_amount
plainFields.description: Internal amount recorded in the platform at the time of detection, if applicable.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency in which the mismatch was detected, typically matching the payment currency.

plainFields.name: resolution_status
plainFields.description: Status of reconciliation (for example "open", "in_progress", "resolved", "won_t_fix").

plainFields.name: resolution_note
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable explanation of how this reconciliation event is being or was resolved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation event was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation event was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_earnings
models.description:
Seller earnings records derived from orders and payments.

Each row represents a unit of earnings for a seller, typically linked to one order item or adjustment, after applying commissions, platform-funded discounts, and seller-funded discounts.

These records serve as the source of truth for payout eligibility and support KPI calculations such as GMV, NMV, and seller net earnings over time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns this earning. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Customer order from which this earning originates. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Specific order item that generated this earning, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Payment associated with this earning when relevant (for example when earnings depend on payment completion). {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id}.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of this earning record.

plainFields.name: gross_amount
plainFields.description: Gross merchandise amount associated with this earning before commissions and platform-funded promotions.

plainFields.name: seller_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of discount funded by the seller for this earning (reduces seller gross earnings).

plainFields.name: platform_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of discount funded by the platform for this earning (does not reduce seller gross earnings, but affects platform cost).

plainFields.name: commission_amount
plainFields.description: Commission amount charged by the platform for this earning.

plainFields.name: other_fee_amount
plainFields.description: Any other fee amount that affects net earnings for this seller (for example per-order fees or adjustments).

plainFields.name: net_earning_amount
plainFields.description: Net amount owed to the seller for this earning after subtracting commissions and seller-funded discounts, plus any adjustments.

plainFields.name: earning_type
plainFields.description: Type of earning (for example "order_item", "shipping", "manual_adjustment").

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of this earning (for example "pending", "eligible", "paid_out", "reversed"). Pending and eligible control payout eligibility.

plainFields.name: eligible_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp at which this earning became eligible for payout (for example after refund window closes).

plainFields.name: reversed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this earning was reversed due to refund, chargeback, or manual adjustment, if applicable.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional serialized metadata describing the commission rule applied, campaign identifiers, or internal notes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this earning record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this earning record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_payout_batches
models.description:
Payout batches aggregating multiple seller earnings for settlement.

Each row represents a payout run or batch in which multiple sellers may be paid, or a specific batch per seller depending on configuration. It captures the payout period, totals, and status.

Payout items attach individual seller earnings to a batch, and external references connect the batch to bank or payment processor instructions.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: batch_code
plainFields.description: Business identifier for this payout batch, unique for traceability (for example "PO-2025-03-15-001").

plainFields.name: payout_period_start
plainFields.description: Start timestamp of the business period that this batch covers for reporting purposes.

plainFields.name: payout_period_end
plainFields.description: End timestamp of the business period that this batch covers for reporting purposes.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for monetary amounts in this payout batch.

plainFields.name: total_gross_amount
plainFields.description: Total gross earnings included in this batch before any adjustments or negative balances.

plainFields.name: total_commission_amount
plainFields.description: Total commission amount associated with earnings included in this batch.

plainFields.name: total_net_payout_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount to be transferred to sellers in this batch after commissions and adjustments.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of this payout batch at business level (for example "draft", "processing", "completed", "failed", "cancelled").

plainFields.name: external_reference
plainFields.description: Optional reference to a bank file, payout run ID, or external instruction identifier associated with this batch.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional internal notes for finance or operations explaining special handling or anomalies in this batch.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout batch was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout batch was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_payout_items
models.description:
Payout batch items linking seller earnings to a batch.

Each row associates a single seller earning with a payout batch and records the amount being paid out in that batch. This table materializes which earnings were settled when and supports reconciliation with both seller statements and platform finance records.

The table is subsidiary to {@link shopping_mall_seller_payout_batches} and {@link shopping_mall_seller_earnings}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_payout_batch_id
foreignFields.description: Payout batch that this payout item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_seller_payout_batches.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_earning_id
foreignFields.description: Seller earning that is being paid in this batch item. {@link shopping_mall_seller_earnings.id}.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the payout amount. Usually matches the batch and earning currency.

plainFields.name: payout_amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid out for this earning in this batch. Normally equals the net_earning_amount, but may differ if partial payouts or previous adjustments exist.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of this payout item (for example "pending", "included", "paid", "reversed").

plainFields.name: paid_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout item was confirmed as paid to the seller, if applicable.

plainFields.name: reversed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout item was reversed due to negative adjustments, chargebacks, or other corrections.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payout item was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description:
High-level customer or seller initiated requests to cancel orders or specific order items.

Represents the business case that a placed order should be cancelled partially or fully, prior to or during fulfillment. Each cancellation request links to a single order but can cover multiple order items via {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_request_items}. It stores the current lifecycle status and key timestamps for SLA monitoring.

These records are permanent audit entities; they are never soft-deleted and form the core of after-order cancellation workflows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the cancellation request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this cancellation request is targeting. {@link shopping_mall_orders}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the cancellation, if the requester is a customer. {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who initiated the cancellation when seller-driven. {@link shopping_mall_sellers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created the cancellation on behalf of another actor or as an operational action. {@link shopping_mall_admins}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_case_sla_config_id
foreignFields.description: SLA configuration that governs this cancellation request, when a dedicated SLA rule applies. {@link shopping_mall_case_sla_configs}.

plainFields.name: request_code
plainFields.description: Business-visible identifier for the cancellation request, unique per order for reference in communications.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the cancellation request, such as pending, approved, rejected, or expired.

plainFields.name: scope_type
plainFields.description: Scope of the cancellation, for example full_order or partial_items, used to distinguish request semantics.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Optional structured reason code selected from policy-defined values, such as change_of_mind or ordered_by_mistake.

plainFields.name: reason_description
plainFields.description: Free-text explanation describing why cancellation is requested, as written by the requester.

plainFields.name: requested_by_actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor type who requested the cancellation, such as customer, seller, or admin, used for governance and analytics.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created in the system.

plainFields.name: decided_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request reached a terminal decision such as approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_items
models.description:
Order item level lines that belong to a cancellation request.

Each row represents a specific order item and quantity that is included in a parent {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests}. This allows partial item-level cancellations and accurate audit of what was requested to be cancelled.

These records are append-only in practice and are not soft-deleted; corrections are done via additional requests or business rules.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the cancellation request item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Parent cancellation request that owns this line. {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item that the cancellation line refers to. {@link shopping_mall_order_items}.

plainFields.name: requested_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the order item that the requester wants to cancel.

plainFields.name: reason_description
plainFields.description: Optional item-specific cancellation explanation, when different from the header reason.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cancellation request item record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
High-level refund cases initiated by customers, sellers, or admins after or around delivery.

Stores the primary business record for a refund case linked to an order and often to a payment. It contains lifecycle status, requested and approved amounts, and links to more granular {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_items} and status histories.

Refund requests are core governance entities and must remain immutable from an audit perspective except for status progression and administrative annotations.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order for which this refund is requested. {@link shopping_mall_orders}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Specific order payment that this refund request is associated with, when applicable. {@link shopping_mall_order_payments}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who requested the refund, when the requester is a customer. {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who initiated the refund or concession, when seller-driven. {@link shopping_mall_sellers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created the refund request, often in manual adjustment scenarios. {@link shopping_mall_admins}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_reason_id
foreignFields.description: Primary structured reason selected for this refund request from the reason catalog. {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_reasons}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: Linked cancellation request when the refund stems from a cancellation case. {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_case_sla_config_id
foreignFields.description: SLA configuration that governs this refund request, if a specific SLA rule applies. {@link shopping_mall_case_sla_configs}.

plainFields.name: request_code
plainFields.description: Business-visible identifier for the refund request, used in support and communication flows.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund request, such as requested, under_review, approved, rejected, or completed.

plainFields.name: requested_total_amount
plainFields.description: Total monetary amount that the requester asks to be refunded, expressed in the order currency.

plainFields.name: approved_total_amount
plainFields.description: Total monetary amount approved to be refunded after review, expressed in the order currency.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency code for the requested and approved amounts, typically matching the order currency (for example, USD or KRW).

plainFields.name: reason_description
plainFields.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the refund request beyond the structured reason code.

plainFields.name: requested_by_actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor type who initiated the refund request, such as customer, seller, or admin.

plainFields.name: requires_return
plainFields.description: Indicates whether physical goods must be returned as part of fulfilling this refund request.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was created in the system.

plainFields.name: decided_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when a final decision was made, such as approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the financial refund was fully processed and completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_items
models.description:
Line-level mapping between refund requests and the specific monetary impact per order item or payment component.

Each record belongs to a {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests} and optionally references an {@link shopping_mall_order_items} or a low-level payment refund item. It captures requested and approved amounts per component, enabling detailed reconciliation.

These rows form the granular basis for how a refund request breaks down financially without storing any derived aggregates.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund request item.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Parent refund request that owns this line. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item that this refund amount is associated with, when the refund targets a specific item. {@link shopping_mall_order_items}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_refund_item_id
foreignFields.description: Underlying payment refund item that implements this refund line at the payment provider level. {@link shopping_mall_payment_refund_items}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_reason_id
foreignFields.description: Specific structured reason associated with this line, which may differ from the header reason. {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_reasons}.

plainFields.name: requested_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the item for which refund is requested, when the refund is quantity-based.

plainFields.name: approved_quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity approved for refund, when the refund is quantity-based and partially accepted.

plainFields.name: requested_amount
plainFields.description: Monetary amount requested to be refunded for this line in the order currency.

plainFields.name: approved_amount
plainFields.description: Monetary amount approved for this line after review, in the order currency.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency code for the requested and approved amounts, typically matching the order currency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request item record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_reasons
models.description:
Catalog of structured reason codes that can be associated with refund and cancellation requests.

Defines stable business-level categories such as change_of_mind, damaged_item, wrong_item, or not_delivered. These reasons are used by both {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests} and {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_items} for consistent analytics and policy enforcement.

Admins can manage these reasons, but they are treated as configuration records rather than primary business cases.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund request reason.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique machine-friendly code representing the refund or cancellation reason, such as damaged_item.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the reason as shown in management tools or localized catalogs.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of when this reason should be used, written for admins or internal staff.

plainFields.name: applies_to_cancellation
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this reason can be used for cancellation requests.

plainFields.name: applies_to_refund
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this reason can be used for refund requests.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this reason is currently allowed for new requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reason record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reason record was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_status_histories
models.description:
Historical record of all status transitions that occurred on a refund request.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the refund request status history entry.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Refund request whose status changed in this history record. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer involved in this status change, when the customer triggered the transition. {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller involved in this status change, when the seller provided a decision or response. {@link shopping_mall_sellers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who performed or recorded this status change. {@link shopping_mall_admins}.

plainFields.name: from_status

plainFields.name: to_status

plainFields.name: changed_by_actor_type

plainFields.name: reason_description

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change took effect.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status history record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status history record was last updated, if ever.

models.name: shopping_mall_disputes

Platform-level disputes that encapsulate high-severity conflicts involving orders, refunds, chargebacks, or policy violations.
