models.name: shopping_mall_order_daily_stats
models.description:
Daily aggregated order and revenue statistics for the entire marketplace.

Each row represents metrics for a single calendar date covering all orders across all sellers and customers. It is populated by ETL or batch jobs based on transactional order, payment, refund, and shipment data.

These aggregates are used to compute GMV, NMV, order counts, item counts, and other high-level KPIs required by business and analytics teams. Rows are typically append-only and updated if recomputation is needed for a given date.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the daily order stats snapshot row.

plainFields.name: stats_date
plainFields.description: Calendar date for which these statistics are calculated. Time component SHOULD be normalized to midnight UTC for consistency.

plainFields.name: order_count
plainFields.description: Total number of successfully created orders on this date, regardless of payment outcome.

plainFields.name: paid_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders that reached a paid state on this date.

plainFields.name: cancelled_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders that were cancelled on this date, including customer- and system-initiated cancellations.

plainFields.name: refunded_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders that had at least one refund completed on this date.

plainFields.name: gmv_amount
plainFields.description: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for orders associated with this date, before refunds and cancellations, expressed in the platform base currency.

plainFields.name: nmv_amount
plainFields.description: Net Merchandise Value (NMV) for this date after subtracting refunded or cancelled amounts, expressed in the platform base currency.

plainFields.name: item_count
plainFields.description: Total number of order line items across all orders created on this date.

plainFields.name: unique_customer_count
plainFields.description: Number of distinct customers who placed at least one order on this date.

plainFields.name: unique_seller_count
plainFields.description: Number of distinct sellers who had at least one item included in orders created on this date.

plainFields.name: average_order_value
plainFields.description: Average order value (AOV) for this date, typically calculated as GMV divided by paid_order_count.

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount refunded on this date across all orders, expressed in the platform base currency.

plainFields.name: chargeback_amount
plainFields.description: Total value of chargebacks recorded on this date, expressed in the platform base currency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot row was first created by the analytics pipeline.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot row was last recomputed or corrected by the analytics pipeline.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_daily_stats
models.description:
Daily aggregated performance and revenue statistics per seller.

Each row represents metrics for a given seller on a specific calendar date. It is populated by analytics or ETL jobs from transactional orders, payments, refunds, shipments, reviews, and risk data.

These statistics help compute seller GMV, earnings, cancellation and refund rates, dispute volumes, and basic operational KPIs used in seller dashboards and risk monitoring.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller daily stats snapshot row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Identifier of the seller to which these daily statistics apply. References the logical {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} in the operational schema.

plainFields.name: stats_date
plainFields.description: Calendar date for which these seller metrics are calculated. Time component SHOULD be normalized to midnight UTC for consistency.

plainFields.name: order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders that included at least one item from this seller created on this date.

plainFields.name: paid_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders that reached a paid state and contained items from this seller on this date.

plainFields.name: cancelled_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of seller-related order segments cancelled on this date, based on seller items only.

plainFields.name: refunded_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of seller-related order segments that had at least one refund completed on this date.

plainFields.name: gmv_amount
plainFields.description: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) attributable to this seller on this date, before refunds and commissions, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: nmv_amount
plainFields.description: Net Merchandise Value (NMV) for this seller on this date after applying refunds or cancellations, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: commission_amount
plainFields.description: Total platform commission charged to this seller on this date for completed items, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: seller_earnings_amount
plainFields.description: Net earnings owed to this seller on this date after commissions and seller-funded discounts, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: unique_customer_count
plainFields.description: Number of distinct customers who purchased at least one item from this seller on this date.

plainFields.name: shipment_created_count
plainFields.description: Number of shipments created for this seller on this date.

plainFields.name: shipment_delivered_count
plainFields.description: Number of shipments for this seller that were marked as delivered on this date.

plainFields.name: late_shipment_count
plainFields.description: Number of shipments for this seller that violated shipping or delivery SLAs on this date.

plainFields.name: dispute_opened_count
plainFields.description: Number of disputes involving this seller that were opened on this date.

plainFields.name: dispute_lost_count
plainFields.description: Number of disputes for this seller that were resolved against the seller (customer-favored or platform-favored) on this date.

plainFields.name: average_rating
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the average product rating for this seller’s catalog as of this date, computed from visible reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_review_count
plainFields.description: Number of reviews considered in the average_rating metric for this seller on this date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller daily snapshot row was first created by the analytics pipeline.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this seller daily snapshot row was last recomputed or corrected by the analytics pipeline.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_daily_stats
models.description:
Daily aggregated activity and revenue statistics per customer.

Each row represents metrics for a single customer on a specific calendar date, derived from orders, carts, wishlists, and engagement actions.

These statistics are used to analyze customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchase behavior, and engagement patterns for growth and marketing teams.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the customer daily stats snapshot row.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id

plainFields.name: stats_date
plainFields.description: Calendar date for which these customer metrics are calculated. Time component SHOULD be normalized to midnight UTC for consistency.

plainFields.name: order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders created by this customer on this date.

plainFields.name: paid_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of this customer’s orders that reached a paid state on this date.

plainFields.name: gmv_amount
plainFields.description: Total gross merchandise value of orders created by this customer on this date, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: nmv_amount
plainFields.description: Net merchandise value for this customer on this date after applying refunds or cancellations, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount refunded to this customer on this date, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: cart_add_count
plainFields.description: Number of add-to-cart actions performed by this customer on this date.

plainFields.name: wishlist_add_count
plainFields.description: Number of wishlist-add actions performed by this customer on this date.

plainFields.name: session_count
plainFields.description: Number of authenticated sessions started by this customer on this date.

plainFields.name: is_new_customer
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this date is considered the customer’s acquisition date (first registration or first order) for analytics purposes.

plainFields.name: has_repeat_orders
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the customer has placed more than one order over their lifetime as of the end of this date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this customer daily snapshot row was first created by the analytics pipeline.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this customer daily snapshot row was last recomputed or corrected by the analytics pipeline.

models.name: shopping_mall_campaign_metrics
models.description:
Aggregated performance metrics for marketing or pricing campaigns.

Each row represents metrics for a specific campaign code on a given date. Campaigns can correspond to vouchers, discounts, or other promotional constructs defined in business configuration layers.

These metrics help marketing and business teams measure GMV, NMV, order volume, new customer acquisition, and promotional cost splits between platform and sellers.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the campaign metrics snapshot row.

plainFields.name: stats_date
plainFields.description: Calendar date for which these campaign metrics are calculated. Time component SHOULD be normalized to midnight UTC for consistency.

plainFields.description: Business identifier of the campaign (for example voucher code, campaign ID, or promotion key) used when pricing rules are applied.

plainFields.name: order_count
plainFields.description: Number of orders on this date that were affected by this campaign.

plainFields.name: paid_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of campaign-affected orders on this date that reached a paid state.

plainFields.name: gmv_amount
plainFields.description: Gross merchandise value attributable to this campaign on this date, before refunds, in platform base currency.

plainFields.description: Net merchandise value attributable to this campaign on this date after refunds or cancellations, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: new_customer_order_count
plainFields.description: Number of paid orders under this campaign on this date created by customers considered new within the campaign attribution rules.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_platform_kpi_snapshots
models.description:
Snapshot table for aggregated platform-level KPIs over arbitrary reporting periods.

Each row stores high-level metrics such as GMV, NMV, platform revenue, take rate, active customers, active sellers, refund and chargeback rates, and other key performance indicators for a defined period.

These snapshots are used for executive dashboards, business reporting, and non-functional monitoring of marketplace health.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the platform KPI snapshot row.

plainFields.name: period_type
plainFields.description: Type of reporting period this KPI snapshot represents, such as "day", "week", "month", or "custom".

plainFields.name: period_start
plainFields.description: Inclusive start timestamp of the reporting period covered by this snapshot.

plainFields.name: period_end
plainFields.description: Exclusive end timestamp of the reporting period covered by this snapshot.

plainFields.name: gmv_amount
plainFields.description: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) for the reporting period, before refunds and cancellations, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: nmv_amount
plainFields.description: Net Merchandise Value (NMV) for the reporting period after applying refunds and cancellations, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: new_customer_count

plainFields.name: refund_request_count
plainFields.description: Number of refund requests created during the reporting period.

plainFields.name: approved_refund_count
plainFields.description: Number of refund requests approved during the reporting period.

plainFields.name: refunded_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount refunded during the reporting period, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: chargeback_count
plainFields.description: Number of chargebacks recorded during the reporting period.

plainFields.name: chargeback_amount
plainFields.description: Total value of chargebacks recorded during the reporting period, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: average_order_value
plainFields.description: Average order value (AOV) for the reporting period, usually computed as GMV divided by paid_order_count.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this KPI snapshot row was first created by the analytics pipeline.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this KPI snapshot row was last recomputed or corrected by the analytics pipeline.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_method_stats

Daily aggregated metrics per payment method.

plainFields.description: Total amount of chargebacks related to this payment method on this date, in platform base currency.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_and_dispute_stats
